name: analyze_fraud_risk
description: Analyze a claim for potential fraud indicators using multi-factor analysis (pattern matching, anomaly detection, behavioral and network analysis). Returns fraud risk score, flagged indicators with severity, and a recommendation (STANDARD_PROCESSING, ENHANCED_REVIEW, or REFER_TO_SIU).

name: check_fraud_patterns
description: Check a claimant's history for fraud patterns across all claims: claim frequency, flagged claims, detected patterns, and watch-list status.

name: generate_fraud_report
description: Generate a formal fraud investigation report for SIU (Special Investigation Unit) review, including evidence summary, risk indicators, financial impact, and recommendation.

investigation_findings.description: Summary of investigation findings for the executive summary

name: get_fraud_dashboard
description: Get fraud detection dashboard metrics and KPIs for the current month: screening volume, detection rate, false positive rate, savings, and top fraud types.
